reason: This PR directly changes planner join-shape enumeration and physical-property/task logic to support a new index join pattern, and it also updates the index lookup join executors/builder/runtime path. That is core optimizer plus executor correctness territory with broad blast radius: plan selection, join correctness, ordering/property propagation, and cleanup/runtime behavior can all regress across many queries. The wide planner testdata churn and coupled executor changes make it worth a dedicated deep review for Blocker/High issues.
